verdict.rationale: INPI Guichet unique is a government portal for filing company formalities: registrations, modifications, cessations and filing deeds. Users cannot build automations on it, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any automation, workflow-definition or version-control feature that would make the axis apply. The dashboards only track the progress of filings.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
